title: Detecting AI Training in Datacentre Power
abstract: arXiv:2610.30182v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI governance agreements require methods to detect large model training runs on a monitored computing cluster, without trusting the operator. We develop a method to detect synchronous model training in facility-level power by Viterbi tracking of the wandering iteration cadence. On simulated datacentre power, when the operator makes no attempt to hide, the Viterbi tracker detects at least $96\%$ of training runs against a declared inference workload, at a $1\%$ false-alarm rate and within $0.04$ of the Neyman--Pearson optimum, given a meter that samples at $2$ Hz or faster. Of eight adversarial strategies an operator might use to hide, only extreme variation of the work per iteration evades the tracker. Its strongest form hides training in up to $73\%$ of five-minute observations, but over a day at least $87\%$ of such runs are still caught, at a $0.1\%$ false-alarm rate per run. translated_title: 检测数据中心电力中的人工智能训练
translated_abstract: 人工智能治理协议需要能够在受监控的计算集群上检测大规模模型训练运行的方法，且无需信任运营者。我们开发了一种方法，通过维特比追踪漂移的迭代节奏，在设施级电力数据中检测同步模型训练。在模拟的数据中心电力数据上，当运营者不做任何隐藏尝试时，在电表采样率为2 Hz或更快的条件下，维特比追踪器在1%误报率下，相对于申报的推理工作负载，能检测出至少96%的训练运行，其性能与奈曼–皮尔逊最优检测器相差不超过0.04。在运营者可能用于隐藏训练的八种对抗性策略中，只有每次迭代工作量的极端变化能够躲避追踪器。其最强形式可在多达73%的五分钟观测窗口中隐藏训练，但在一天的时间尺度上，此类运行仍至少有87%会被捕获，每次运行的误报率为0.1%。该对抗性策略不损失吞吐量，但（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于维特比追踪迭代节奏的方法，能从数据中心设施级电力数据中检测未申报的AI模型训练，即使运营者采用对抗性隐藏策略，一天内仍能以极低误报率捕获至少87%的训练运行。
en_tdlr: A Viterbi-tracking method detects undeclared AI model training from datacentre facility-level power data, catching at least 87% of training runs over a day even against adversarial hiding strategies, with a near-Neyman–Pearson-optimal 96% detection rate when no hiding is attempted.
